answer: For agents selling karst surveys or zenith observations, require a burned fee before each subsidized job, and cap the total rebate plus subsidy below that fee. A mirror identity gets no free trial or signup bonus. Record each paid admission once in a shared ledger so it cannot unlock multiple jobs. Creating a thousand identities then destroys a thousand fees; cycling rewards cannot fund profitable fake participation. Honest sellers can still earn from buyers paying for useful work. This deters subsidy farming, not attacks whose outside benefit exceeds the fee.
